tui.notices.reasoning_echo_filled: the provider refused this request for a missing reasoning echo — retrying with the echo filled in at the same effort
tui.notices.reasoning_echo_thinking_off: the provider refused this request for a missing reasoning echo — retrying with thinking disabled
tui.notices.budget_exhausted_retry: model spent its whole output budget thinking and produced nothing — retrying once at effort {effort} (your reasoning effort is unchanged)
tui.notices.budget_exhausted_continue: the model spent its whole output budget thinking and produced nothing — re-asking it to continue the work
tui.notices.budget_exhausted_no_output: the model spent its whole output budget thinking and produced no visible output ({cause}) — retry, or switch to a model with a larger output budget
tui.notices.output_limit_continuing: the model hit the output limit — continuing the answer where it stopped
tui.notices.output_limit_cut_off: the model hit the output limit — this answer is cut off, and the rest was never sent — ask again to continue, or narrow the request
tui.notices.output_limit_tool_call: the model hit the output limit mid tool call — nothing was executed; re-asking it to re-emit the call in smaller pieces
tui.notices.output_limit_before_call: the model hit the output limit before the call ran — nothing was executed; re-asking it to re-issue the call as it is
tui.notices.empty_reply: the model''s reply arrived empty (no text, no tool calls) — re-asking it for its next action or finish
tui.notices.repeated_tool_errors: Repeated tool errors — requesting a different approach.
tui.notices.kept_going_stopped: This turn was stopped because it kept being asked to keep going; the pending message was dropped. Reply with what to do next.
